1. (Currently Amended) An assembly comprising a test tube with an affixed MTP, wherein the MTP is embedded in the test tube at a specific depth of __at least 0.5 mm below the outer surface__.

2. (Currently Amended) The assembly of claim 1, wherein the MTP is embedded in the test tube __such that the MTP is not visible from the exterior of the test tube without magnification__.

3. (Currently Amended) The assembly of claim 1, wherein the MTP is embedded underneath the __bottom surface of the test tube, oriented for reading downwards through the bottom of the test tube__.

4. (Currently Amended) The assembly of claim 1, wherein the test tube is a biorepository test tube __designed for long-term cryogenic storage of biological samples__.

5. (Currently Amended) The assembly of claim 1, wherein the MTP is embedded in polypropylene or acetal polymer __and wherein the polymer is injection molded around the MTP__.

6. (Currently Amended) The assembly of claim 1, wherein the MTP is embedded near the center bottom of the __test tube__.
